headline: Krungsri Finnovate joins Amity's US$100 million-plus Series D round
body: Krungsri Finnovate has joined Thai AI firm Amity's Series D funding round, which is more than US$100 million. The amount was not disclosed. Amity's executive chairman, Korawad Chearavanont, said the firm is pursuing long-term growth plans, including a potential IPO.
note: For Thai lenders, the more concrete signal is the planned data partnership, which the two companies describe as preliminary.

evidence.text: Krungsri Finnovate has joined Thai AI firm Amity ‘s Series D funding round of more than US$100 million.
The investment came through Finnoventure Private Equity Trust I, a fund managed by Krungsri Finnovate, as an extension to the round.
Amity and Krungsri are exploring commercial opportunities, including a preliminary data partnership with Amity’s subsidiary EGG Digital.
Korawad Chearavanont, Executive Chairman and Founder of Amity, said,

Having a vote of confidence from one of Thailand’s leading financial institutions not only validates the momentum of our $100 million-plus Series D extension, but also reinforces our deep roots in the local market as we continue pursuing our long-term growth plans, including a potential IPO.”
